```{r setup}
library(bio.dogma)
```

Link to GitHub repository: https://github.com/rforbiodatascience26/group_17_package

Bio.dogma is a R package built for executing DNA translation and RNA translation to amino acids and counting the frequency of the amino acids for a given sequence.

Function 1 - DNA sequence: Generates a random DNA sequences of a given length.

-   Description: DNA sequence

-   Usage: DNA_sequence(length)

-   Arguments: length length of DNA sequence

-   Value: DNA sequence of size = length

Function 2 - Gen_RNA: Converts DNA to RNA by replacing T’s to U’s.

-   Description: RNA Generator

-   Usage: gen_RNA(DNAseq)

-   Arguments: DNAseq is a string containing a DNA sequence

-   Value: the corresponding RNA sequence

Function 3 - codon_chopper: RNA is converted to codons relying on set open reading frame.

-   Description: codon_chopper

-   Usage: codon_chopper(dna_string, start = 1)

-   Arguments: dna_string dna string to chop start index to start chopping at

-   Value: codons of the dna string

Function 4 – translator: Each codon is translated to its corresponding amino acid of the codon usage table.

-   Description: translator

-   Usage: translator(codons)

-   Arguments: codons an index for the table containing codons

-   Value: a string of the table

Function 5 - AA_counter: Amino acid frequency for the sequence is plotted.

-   Description: Amino Acid Counter

-   Usage: AA_counter(AA_seq)

-   Arguments: AA_seq is a string of amino acids

-   Value: a plot of amino acid frequencies
